interpretation: The predeclared floor-aware protocol did not rescue calibration case 1. The common N<=512 ladder classified the case as not floor-resolved, so the N=1024/2048 extension was mandatory and correctly failed closed when the N=1024 trajectory did not converge. This run therefore cannot support a finite-reference error-bound calibration.
diagnostic_gap: The harness emitted the exact d_128, d_256 and machine-floor values only after a successful extended run, so the failure log proves the EXTENDED_REQUIRED decision but does not expose those three values. A trace-only diagnostic repeat may expose them without changing the protocol or numerical calculation.
